fixed_statement:
The assumptions of Lemma 5.1 hold.

For every unit \(w\in K\),
\[
|dG(w)|^2J_2F\le1,
\]
and
\[
\|dG|_{\ker dF}\|_{HS}^2J_2F\le2 .
\]
fixed_proof:
By Claim 5.1.1,
\[
|dG(w)|^2J_2F=|dG(w)|^2ab\le b/a\le1.
\]
Since \(K\) is two-dimensional, summing over an orthonormal basis gives the Hilbert-Schmidt estimate.
